craptech_toggle_airjacks.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechAirJacks') if c then c.toggle() end
craptech_toggle_airjacks.title: Toggle air jacks
craptech_toggle_airjacks.desc: Crapouille air jacks: lift the car on its jacks, or drop it back down

craptech_toggle_track.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechAirJacks') if c then c.toggleTrack() end
craptech_toggle_track.title: Toggle wide / narrow track
craptech_toggle_track.desc: The wheels move a few cm out (or back in) while the car is up on the Crapouille air jacks (raise them first)

craptech_jato_deploy.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechJato') if c then c.toggleDeploy() end
craptech_jato_deploy.title: Crapouille JATO: deploy / retract
craptech_jato_deploy.desc: Bumper panels slide down and the two rockets come out (or go back in). Needs the wide track, the race kit and the wing out

craptech_jato_fire.onDown: local c = controller.getController('craptechJato') if c then c.toggleFire() end
craptech_jato_fire.title: Crapouille JATO: fire / stop
craptech_jato_fire.desc: Light or stop the two bumper rockets (they must be deployed)
